name: text-generate-effect
title: Text Generate Effect
description: Takes a sentence and splits it into words that fade in from a blur one after another, so the line assembles itself on load. It plays once and settles as plain bold text.
use: A short statement should draw the eye as it assembles the first time it is seen.
avoid: The copy is critical and must be readable at once, or it sits far below the fold.
a11y: The blur-in reveal runs even under reduced-motion; the text is plain and readable once it finishes. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A single bold white sentence across a black stage, set in two centred lines. In early frames the tail of the sentence is soft and blurred while the opening words are already crisp.
behaves: On mount the words reveal left to right, each one lifting from blurred and transparent to sharp white with a short stagger, until the whole line is legible. It runs once and never repeats.
customise: words is the sentence; className, filter and duration control styling, whether words blur, and length. The 0.2s stagger and 10px blur are fixed in the source.
weight: light: One sentence split into spans that animate a single time.
